report.summary: Impact between car-0 and car-1 occurred at t = 4.676 s, with timing uncertainty about 0.042 s. From t = 3.476 to 4.476 s, car-0 was measured at 31.2 km/h (90% interval 29.4 to 33.7) and car-1 was measured at 52.4 km/h (90% interval 49.3 to 57.6). The speed claim for the white car is not consistent with the footage, while the speed claim for the blue car is consistent with the footage. The claim that the white car did not brake is consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact. The claim that the light was green cannot be checked from the footage.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; where dropped frames fall within each second is not known, which the speed intervals include.
Road calibration error: 0.355 m (how well the clicked road points fit a flat road); positions assume a flat road.

The momentum check after the impact did not balance (inconsistent): after contact the vehicles overlap in the image, so post-impact motion is not reliable. Speeds before the impact are measured separately and are not affected.
